concept_short: Reel-to-reel contactless REBCO tape quality metrology (Hall-array critical-current mapping + delamination screening) sold to tape vendors and magnet builders as certified acceptance instrumentation.
800-VDC rack power-path protection
Standards-grade thermal emulation and conformance metrology
Coherent-beam-combining phase-control engine

Multi-terminal DC fault-discrimination protection relay plus vendor-neutral hardware-in-the-loop qualification platform for MVDC datacenter distribution and HVDC converter stations - the 'SEL of DC grids.'
300C-class mixed-signal instrumentation electronics platform (SiC/SOI) for superhot geothermal, downhole, and turbine environments
Merchant quench-detection-and-protection subsystem for REBCO/HTS magnets
Vendor-neutral ion-energy-distribution metrology + tailored-waveform bias control retrofit for plasma etch chambers
Precision GaN pump-driver and laser-power modules
Solid-state microsecond impedance-matching engines (switched SiC/PIN capacitor arrays replacing motorized vacuum-capacitor matchboxes) for pulsed and tailored-waveform RF plasma tools
US merchant NEG-coating and low-outgassing surface engineering line for UHV/XHV chambers (accelerators, quantum, EUV, space simulation)
Standardized solid-state pulsed-power platform
Electrolyzer stack degradation-emulation and bankability test systems
Thermal-shock-tolerant printed-circuit heat exchangers (PCHE)
DC-conversion acceptance and commissioning instrumentation

High-density cryogenic interconnect loader with co-packaged 4K readout front-end (superconducting flex harness + cryo-CMOS multiplexing + cryo-LNA), breaking the 256-channel-per-loader wall for quantum computers.
Charge-buildup-immune beam current and dose metrology for ultra-high-dose-rate (FLASH) and industrial electron beams -- the traceable ammeter the field admits it lacks.
Modular plasma destruction units for concentrated PFAS waste streams (spent AFFF, IX regenerant, membrane reject) for DoD and water utilities
PFAS-free pumped two-phase direct-to-chip cooling loop
Distributed composite-flywheel kinetic buffers for off-grid AI power plants
Inline-metrology plasma surface-treatment machines for PCB and advanced-packaging substrates
In-service coolant-health monitoring and side-stream conditioning skids for liquid-cooled AI-datacenter fleets (chemistry, particulates, bio-fouling, wear-metal telemetry with automated correction)
PEM electrolyzer 'protective operating envelope' controllers with warranty-grade black-box logging
Merchant 100 kWe-class space closed-Brayton power conversion unit and high-voltage PMAD for fission surface power -- the converter layer for the reactor decade.
